description.p: Musa CAD is a 2D drafting application for technical, architectural and engineering drawings. It follows AutoCAD's ribbon, command line, prompts and shortcuts, so a drafter's habits carry over, and its multi-threaded, GPU-accelerated core keeps even large drawings smooth to pan, zoom and edit.

ul.li: Lines, polylines with widths, arcs, circles, ellipses, splines, hatches and gradients
Move, copy, rotate, scale, stretch, trim, extend, fillet, offset and arrays, with grips
Object snaps, polar and object snap tracking, and dynamic input at the cursor
Dimensions, leaders, text, tables and geometric tolerancing
Layers, linetypes, lineweights, blocks with attributes and external references
Layouts with viewports, and plotting to PDF or a printer
DXF read and write; DWG through the free ODA File Converter
Several drawings open at once in tabs

description.p: Text and dimensions as AutoCAD has them: TEXT with its fifteen justifications and line after line of entry, the Dimension Style Manager with a live preview and named styles, dimension text that moves with its dimension line, DIMLINEAR and DIMANGULAR with every option, polyline widths, one-pick object snaps, polar and object snap tracking, and an update check that says when a new version is out.

AutoCAD's conventions: the ribbon laid out as AutoCAD's, every edit command starting at Select objects with the full keyword set, lassos and click-click boxes, the inquiry commands with running totals and LIST's blocks, the Drawing Units and Purge dialogs, a one-click download of the DWG converter, and the draw and modify commands brought to AutoCAD's prompts option for option.

Sheets and symbols: layouts with viewports and paper space, block authoring, attributes, external references, raster images on screen, and the remaining draw and modify commands (SPLINE, ELLIPSE, POLYGON, BREAK, LENGTHEN, ALIGN and more).
Editing and inquiry: STRETCH, the measurement commands (DIST, ID, AREA, LIST) and dimension chaining (DIMCONTINUE, DIMBASELINE).
Annotation: dimension tolerances and fits, geometric tolerancing (feature control frames and datums), tables, dimension text control, and a documented command line.
First public release. Capable but early: 2D drafting, modify, dimensions, text, blocks, hatches, layers, DXF I/O, and vector PDF plotting.
